verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into his Deathbringer Stance procs and eat Infernal Chains clean; you win if you stack Q into a W stun before he can reset.

brief.thesis: K'Sante holds the lane and solo-kill edge because his Q (Ntofo Strikes) stacks into a shockwave pull that guarantees his W (Path Maker) stun lands, while Aatrox's only real engage tool, W (Infernal Chains), is dodgeable on a long cooldown. The matchup still nets out even overall because Aatrox's passive sustain and Umbral Dash healing let him claw back any trade he isn't punished for immediately.

theirWindow.when: His W (Infernal Chains) lands on you
theirWindow.what: If you don't walk out of the impact circle you get dragged to center and take the damage a second time — that double-hit is what funds his all-in, so treat a landed chain as a forced fight.

yourWindow.when: His W (Infernal Chains) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: With no peel tool up, walk Q (Ntofo Strikes) onto him twice to trigger the 2-stack shockwave pull, then W (Path Maker) for the stun — this is your cleanest kill window all lane.

start.why: The higher-win-rate, most-picked start (48.5% over 2656 games) — sustains you through the early auto trades Aatrox's Deathbringer Stance is built around.

boots.why: Most-picked and best-performing boots here (46.7% over 2396 games) — mitigates his Q (The Darkin Blade) swings and Deathbringer-empowered autos, which are his main source of repeated damage.

core.why: Grievous Wounds early cuts into both Deathbringer Stance heals and Umbral Dash sustain before they snowball.
Adds a slow on top of Q (Ntofo Strikes), making it easier to land your stacked shockwave into W stun.
Completes the Grievous Wounds package and punishes him for attacking into you once sustain fights start.
Highest win-rate full build path (55% over 160 games) — turns you into the wall that closes out the lane's even late-game shape.

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs on your first auto in a trade for bonus true damage and max health, rewarding the Q-slow-into-stick pattern you want against Aatrox's short-duration engage tools.

summoners.why: Teleport is run in 71.2% of games for wave/tower management and roams once the lane stabilizes; Flash+Ignite (47.9% win rate) is the higher-performing flex if you're confident you can convert the solo-kill advantage into an early kill.

playing.title: Stack Q before you commit
playing.detail: Land Q (Ntofo Strikes) twice to trigger the 2-stack shockwave pull before going for anything — it drags him into range and removes his ability to walk out of your W (Path Maker) stun.

playing.title: Walk out of Infernal Chains
playing.detail: If his W lands, leave the impact circle immediately or use E (Footwork) to dash clear — getting dragged to center doubles the damage and is the setup for his all-in.

playing.title: Trade right after his Q swings
playing.detail: The Darkin Blade empowers across three swings; punish him once he's used them or whenever it's down (14/12/10/8/6s) since he has no immediate follow-up damage.

playing.title: Deny Deathbringer Stance value
playing.detail: Watch for his passive auto lighting up and avoid extended auto-trades into it; prefer poking with Q so his empowered hit lands on nothing.

playing.title: Hold E for his dash-in, not just engage
playing.detail: Umbral Dash (9-5s cooldown) both repositions and heals him on champion damage — save your E (Footwork) shield to survive it rather than burning it purely to start fights.

playing.title: Rush Bramble into Thornmail
playing.detail: Grievous Wounds online early keeps Deathbringer Stance and Umbral Dash sustain from compounding into the mid-game power spike that swings this matchup to him.

playing.title: Use R to finish, not to open
playing.detail: All Out (R) commits you to a brawl with reduced defenses after the knockback — only use it once your Q/W combo is already landing for a kill, not as an opener.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win rates are measured from live games on the current patch (OP.GG); the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern calls are my own read of the matchup.
